purpose: GW2 matched comparison (control vs hypothesis-feedback treatment, D136-D145): fresh deterministic engine observations on the two QA evidence builds (QX-41, QX-73, unchanged), the same scripts as p7-generation-1, and AI-vs-AI matches on 12 new seeds. One bundle, partitioned once, serves every session of both arms byte-identically.
selection: Every listed script is run once on every listed build of the run (scripts are deterministic: the build engine and referee decide every outcome).
Every seed x first mover x build of the run is played once with the listed policy in both seats.
All outputs are kept in the order defined by their anonymous ids; nothing is filtered, selected, re-run or regenerated. The run refuses an existing output directory.
No agent output, hypothesis or evaluation result is an input of generation or of the partition procedure.
notes: Seeds 98401-98412 are disjoint from GW1 (97001-97008), P5 (98001-98006) and P7 (98201-98212). Scripted cases are deterministic, so the scripts replay earlier cases under new ids; the novelty is in the matches.
Generated through gamewatch/gw2/generate-p7.ts (the unchanged P5 generator with the P7 scripts registered). No new script and no generator change.
Frozen in its own commit before any matched-comparison observation was generated; no agent output, hypothesis or evaluation result is an input.
Contamination (T25): B1-B3 are publicly documented in this repository and P7 results are published; new seeds do not remove prior knowledge of the defects. The same holds for both arms.
